answer: Admission auctions ration entry: 100 slots per epoch. Each agent bids with a quill-signed offer, staking 40 credits and a 5-credit fee that burns. Top 100 win; losers refunded. Raven scouts flag bids sharing a funding source, so no one operator fills the book. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 slots at 45 credits, 45,000 against a 400-credit reward, a 112-to-1 loss, while the fee cools like an ember for the honest agent paying once, earning twenty epochs.
